```{r}
# Discrepancy plots
lines <- data.frame(
    quartiles = c(
        summary(abs(pse$discrepancy[discrep$type == "Homogenous"]))[c(2, 3, 5)],
        summary(abs(pse$discrepancy[discrep$type == "Heterogenous"]))[c(2, 3, 5)]
    ),
    type = rep(unique(discrep$type), each = 3)
)
discrep |>
    ggplot(aes(abs(discrepancy))) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "cornflowerblue") +
    geom_vline(data = lines, aes(xintercept = quartiles),
    # linetype = 2,
    # alpha = 0.7,
    color = "red") +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
    facet_wrap(~type)
```

```{r}
excludeid <- which(
    abs(pse$discrepancy) > ifelse(
        pse$type == "Homogenous",
        summary(abs(pse$discrepancy[pse$type == "Homogenous"]))[5],
        summary(abs(pse$discrepancy[pse$type == "Heterogenous"]))[5]
    )
)
```

```{r}
homogenous_priors <- c(
    prior(normal(0, 100), class = Intercept),
    prior(normal(1, 0.1), class = b, coef = "standard")
)
homogenous_model <- brm(
    PSEtotal ~ standard + (1|Participant),
    data = pse[pse$type == "Homogenous",],
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = homogenous_priors,
    sample_prior = "yes",
    chains = 6,
    cores = 6,
    iter = 8000,
    warmup = 1000,
    thin = 4,
    seed = 1
)
summary(homogenous_model)
# Notes to self - check pilot hetero data for priors, make sure to format data files for new code, push changes now to github, then push dataset changes in a separate commit.
```
